text: 2026中国算力大会上，中国算力大会“年度重大突破成果”正式揭晓，15项具有示范性意义的技术成果集中亮相。据了解，2026“算力中国·年度重大突破成果”具有四大特点：一是成果整体技术指标先进，在算力及相关产业领域具备国际先进、国内领先水准，具备行业标杆价值；二是核心技术创新性突出，成果转化落地成效显著，具备较强的行业示范、引领带动与辐射推广作用；三是有效提升行业整体技术能级，赋能产业创新，培育新兴业态，催生新经济增长点；四是注重技术创新的社会效益、经济效益和环境效益，对科技发展具有较大推动作用。
text_en: At the 2026 China Computing Conference, the China Computing Conference "Annual Major Breakthrough Achievements" were officially announced, with 15 demonstrative technological achievements unveiled together. It is understood that the 2026 "Computing China · Annual Major Breakthrough Achievements" have four major characteristics: first, the overall technical indicators of the achievements are advanced, reaching internationally advanced and domestically leading levels in computing power and related industries, and possessing industry benchmark value; second, the core technologies are highly innovative, the results of commercialization and implementation are remarkable, and they have strong industry demonstration, guiding, driving, and diffusion effects; third, they effectively raise the overall technological level of the industry, empower industrial innovation, cultivate emerging business forms, and create new economic growth points; fourth, they emphasize the social, economic, and environmental benefits of technological innovation, and have a significant role in promoting scientific and technological development.
